project.title: Gut metagenome
project.description: Investigate the microecological distribution and compositional differences in the gut microbiota of individuals experiencing pregnancy loss compared to healthy controls using metagenomic sequencing.
project.center_name: THE SECOND HOSPITAL & CLINICAL MEDICAL SCHOOL, LANZHOU UNIVERSITY
